realtime.principle: Optimistic UI with server reconciliation. The client reflects expected state transitions immediately on local events, then reconciles when the authoritative server event arrives. Stale states older than 30 seconds trigger a silent re-fetch.
realtime.transport: WebSocket (Socket.IO) with automatic fallback to SSE for restricted networks. V1 implementation uses a mock event emitter on a 4-second interval to simulate real-time progression for demo and development purposes.
clientBehavior: On 'pm.location_updated': interpolate map marker position smoothly over 1s ease-out curve.
On 'appointment.state_changed': advance timeline stepper with a subtle slide-down animation and pulse the new active node.
On 'pm.assigned': reveal the PM card with a fade-in (300ms) and populate fields progressively.
On 'pm.eta_updated': update the ETA field in the PM card with a soft number-flip transition.
On disconnect: show a minimal 'Reconnecting...' banner after 3s, auto-retry with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, max 30s).
On 'appointment.completed': transition the status pill to 'Completed', lock the timeline, and surface a 'View Report' action.
On 'appointment.cancelled': grey out the timeline, show a calm inline notice with reason if provided.
On reconnect: silently fetch full current state and reconcile timeline position without jarring resets.
